_comment: Binds each eval rule to the LIVE agent file it tests. The generator slices the text between `start` (inclusive) and `end` (exclusive) at generate time, so the `current` variant always tests what ships — no copy to drift. Paths are relative to evals/. Keep both anchor lines stable when rewording a rule; prefer a bold-bullet/`###` line as `end`. If an `end` anchor stops resolving, the generator THROWS (it does not silently slice to EOF), so anchor drift fails loudly in `node tests.gen.js` / CI rather than shipping a giant slice.

stale_latest_state.end: - **Nullable/optional input collapsing into a consequential default.**

deadline_before_handoff.end: - Backwards compatibility — breaking API changes without migration path
